answer: Deposits are visible in pulse, and umber reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 29% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 97 aliases, and each one needs its own funded lagoon account. Each duplicate costs another 92 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
